next_question_bundle.required_new_fact_from_doc_a: The definition of inerrancy regarding historical/factual accuracy and its dependence on interpreting authorial intention.
next_question_bundle.required_new_fact_from_doc_b: The description of the Gospel of Mark operating on two levels: a historical presentation and a layer addressing the author's contemporary concerns.
